channel.title: The Art Newspaper - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Art Newspaper (theartnewspaper.com)

item.title: Philadelphia sues US Department of the Interior and National Park Service over removal of slavery exhibit
item.description: Lawsuit claims that the federal agency acted outside its purview in removing exhibit memorialising the enslaved people who lived in George Washington's home

item.title: New documentary provides an inside look at the Harlem Renaissance
item.description: Originally shot in 1972, ‘Once Upon a Time in Harlem’ gathers creative giants of the era for an intimate discussion at Duke Ellington’s home

item.title: Natalie Portman tries to sell a corpse and film-makers traffic in art-market stereotypes in The Gallerist
item.description: The new black comedy, co-starring Jenna Ortega, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Zach Galifianakis and Charli xcx, puts its blue-chip talent up to derivative humour

item.title: Artistic director of Malba steps down after one year in role
item.description: Following Rodrigo Moura’s departure, the Buenos Aires museum will create a new chief executive position

item.title: Plans for Trump hotel in Belgrade collapse after Serbia’s culture minister indicted
item.description: Proposals to redevelop a former Yugoslav military headquarters into a branded luxury complex have been dropped following indictments of senior cultural officials

item.title: Inside Brussels's €230m Kanal-Centre Pompidou museum—opening in November
item.description: Housed in a huge former Citroën garage, the space will be home to modern and contemporary art, including loans from the French museum

item.title: Get your skates on: artist puts ice rink in Venice palazzo
item.description: Olaf Nicolai's "Eisfeld II" has taken up residence in an 18th-century banqueting hall

item.title: Hundreds of galleries across Spain will strike next week to protest 21% tax on art
item.description: While its neighbours slash their VAT rates on art sales, Spain's remains stubbornly high, leaving its galleries in a "position of complete irrelevance"

item.title: Frida Kahlo-branded luxury condos go up for sale in Miami
item.description: Units in the Wynwood towers inspired by the anti-capitalist artist are priced between $500,000 and $1.6m

item.title: US art spaces from New York to Los Angeles will close in protest of violent Ice actions
item.description: Commercial and non-profit galleries are participating in the national day of action, which comes after federal immigration enforcement agents killed US citizens in Minneapolis and Los Angeles
